_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. visual.app declares its design-token layer in its stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json): theme-invariant scales under core.* and every theme-switching name — the --neutral-*/--green-* scales and the shadcn semantics (--background, --primary, --accent, --border-*, --ring) — emitted under both light.* and dark.* so each theme resolves its own value. Declared HSL channel triplets are normalised to hex. The dark theme is declared, never painted while signed out. Measured roles alias to the declared values where they match.
